title: Resumen
leadDue: Your next payments on {{count}} cards come to <c>{{total}}</c>. First up, {{card}}: <m>{{amount}}</m> by {{date}}.

invite.text: Connect the AI tool on your computer and I will sort your spending into categories and tell you where you can save.

due.title: What you pay
due.statementNote: Your statement is in. Minimum payment {{minimum}}.
due.estimatedNote: Your statement closes on {{date}}; the amount is my estimate.
due.estimatedShort: Your statement is not in yet; the amount is my estimate.
due.fixed: Fixed costs such as rent come to <m>{{amount}}</m> this month; they are not paid by card, so they are not in the total.
due.none: There is no statement to pay right now.
due.loadError: I could not get your payments. The back end may be down.

left.title: Installments left
left.sentence_one: You still owe <m>{{amount}}</m> on {{count}} installment purchase. The last installment is in {{month}}.
left.sentence_other: You still owe <m>{{amount}}</m> in total on {{count}} installment purchases. The last installment is in {{month}}.
left.chart: Installment totals for the next 12 months

suggestions.title: Ways to save
suggestions.aiHint: These come from my own calculations only. Connect the AI tool and it will look at your spending and add suggestions.
suggestions.loadError: I could not get the suggestions.

price_rise.title: {{merchant}} costs more now
price_rise.body: It went from <m>{{previous}}</m> to <m>{{last}}</m>. If you use it, look at a cheaper plan; if not, cancel it.

duplicate_service.title: You have {{count}} subscriptions doing the same job
duplicate_service.body: {{merchants}} do the same thing. Drop one and you keep <m>{{saving}}</m> a month.

card_fee.title: You can ask for the card fee back
card_fee.body: You paid a <m>{{amount}}</m> fee on {{card}}. Use the letter on the Rights screen to ask your bank for it.

interest.title: You are paying interest on {{card}}
interest.body: The {{month}} statement has <m>{{amount}}</m> of interest and tax. Pay the full balance by the due date and it goes away.

foreign_currency.title: You spend in foreign currency
foreign_currency.body: Over the last three months you spent <m>{{amount}}</m> a month in foreign currency. Use a card with no foreign transaction fee for it.

frequent_place.title: You spend {{amount}} a month at {{merchant}}
frequent_place.body: Halve this {{category}} spending and you keep <m>{{yearly}}</m> a year.

installment_relief.title: Your installments go down in {{month}}
installment_relief.body: That month your installments come to <m>{{amount}}</m>. You could set the freed amount aside.

where.title: Where your money goes
where.sentence: In {{month}} you spent <m>{{total}}</m>. Most of it on {{top}}: <m>{{amount}}</m>.
where.loadError: I could not get your spending.

load.loadError: I could not get the installment plan.

alerts.label: Alertas
alerts.unknown: Hay una alerta que esta versión no reconoce.

installment_ending.title: Última cuota de {{description}}
installment_ending.detail: El estado de cuenta de {{month}} trae la última cuota: <m>{{amount}}</m>. Desde el mes siguiente ya no la pagas.

limit_high.title: Tu límite está por agotarse
limit_high.detail: El total del estado de cuenta es <m>{{total}}</m> y el límite de la tarjeta <m>{{limit}}</m>. Ya usaste el {{share}} por ciento.

interest_charged.title: Se cobraron intereses
interest_charged.detail: El estado de cuenta de {{month}} tiene <m>{{total}}</m> de intereses.

fee_charged.title: Se cobró una comisión
fee_charged.detail: El estado de cuenta de {{month}} tiene <m>{{total}}</m> de comisiones. Si es la anualidad, puedes pedir que te la devuelvan.

tax_charged.title: Se cobraron impuestos
tax_charged.detail: El estado de cuenta de {{month}} tiene <m>{{total}}</m> de BSMV y KKDF.

foreign_currency.title: Gasto en moneda extranjera
foreign_currency.detail: En el estado de cuenta de {{month}}, el gasto en {{currencies}} llegó a <m>{{total}}</m>.

missing_statement.title: {{card}}: statement missing
missing_statement.detail: The {{range}} {{what}} missing. Download the PDF from your bank’s app and drop it on the Statements screen.

subscription_price_rise.title: {{merchant}} subió de precio
subscription_price_rise.detail: El cobro pasó de <m>{{previous}}</m> a <m>{{last}}</m>, un aumento del {{change}} por ciento.

due_soon.title: Vence el {{date}}
due_soon.detail: El saldo del estado de cuenta es <m>{{total}}</m>; el pago mínimo es <m>{{minimum}}</m>.
due_soon.today: La fecha límite de pago es hoy.

statement_overdue.title: El estado de cuenta de {{card}} está atrasado
statement_overdue.detail: El corte debía ser el {{date}}. Cuando subas el estado de cuenta, se actualizan el pronóstico y las alertas.

charged_after_cancel.title: {{merchant}} hizo un cobro después de que cancelaste
charged_after_cancel.detail: Marcaste la cancelación el {{date}}; después se cobraron <m>{{total}}</m>. Puedes reclamarlo en tu banco.

first.lead: Cuando subas el estado de cuenta de tu tarjeta, aquí te muestro el pronóstico del siguiente, las alertas y tu carga de cuotas.
first.title: Empieza en dos pasos
first.label: Primeros pasos
first.uploadBody: Elige el estado de cuenta en PDF de tu banco. El código lee en este equipo los montos y las cuotas.
first.aiTitle: Si quieres, elige una herramienta para el comentario
first.aiBody: Para las categorías y el comentario uso una herramienta de IA en tu computadora. Las cuotas y el pronóstico funcionan sin ella.
